description:
Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.

    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Custom machine project started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start</bpmn:outgoing>

    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveSets" name="Give Lego sets to children">

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GiveSort</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SortSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_BuildSplit" name="Start subcomponent builds">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SortSplit</bpmn:incoming>

    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeCheck_A</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsCheck_A" name="Parts available in container?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeCheck_A</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PartsYes_A</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PartsNo_A</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Build_A" name="Build subcomponent A">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PartsYes_A</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuildTest_A</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Reorder_A" name="Reorder individual parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PartsNo_A</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReorderMerge_A</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test_A" name="Test subcomponent A">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuildTest_A</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestGw_A</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Test_A" name="Test of subcomponent A successful?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestGw_A</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestOk_A</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestFail_A</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Redesign_A" name="Redesign and rebuild subcomponent A">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestFail_A</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RedesignMerge_A</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildMerge_B" name="Build or rebuild subcomponent B">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_B</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReorderMerge_B</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RedesignMerge_B</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeCheck_B</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsCheck_B" name="Parts available in container?">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PartsYes_B</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PartsNo_B</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Build_B" name="Build subcomponent B">

    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuildTest_B</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestGw_B</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Test_B" name="Test of subcomponent B successful?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestGw_B</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestOk_B</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestFail_B</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestFail_B</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RedesignMerge_B</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestJoin" name="All subcomponents tested successfully">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestOk_A</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestOk_B</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinAssemble</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Assemble" name="Assemble subcomponents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinAssemble</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssembleEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="Custom machine built">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssembleEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_Design"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DesignOrder" sourceRef="Task_Design" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestGw_B" sourceRef="Task_Test_B" targetRef="Gateway_Test_B"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestOk_B" name="successful" sourceRef="Gateway_Test_B" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestFail_B" name="not successful" sourceRef="Gateway_Test_B" targetRef="Task_Redesign_B"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RedesignMerge_B" sourceRef="Task_Redesign_B" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge_B"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinAssemble" sourceRef="Gateway_TestJoin" targetRef="Task_Assemble"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssembleEnd" sourceRef="Task_Assemble" targetRef="EndEvent_1"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
